body:
I can confirm the issue, as mentioned on OP only happens with `Mobile` both on `Vulkan` and `D3D12`. I was able to reproduce down to 4.7 dev 5 (when the `AreaLight3D` was added) so seems to be an existing issue from the implementation. CC @CookieBadger


Godot v4.8.dev (f4c57c282) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8826) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

Seems like a duplicate of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/119183

Does the issue go away if you increase the `subdivision_width` and `subdivision_depth` of the plane?

> Does the issue go away if you increase the subdivision_width and subdivision_depth of the plane? Unfortunately no. I tried some values but nothing changed.


> Seems like a duplicate of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/119183 Doesn't seem to be the case here, the mentioned issue is related with the shadow, but here there's no shadow enabled. Also, this one only happens on `Mobile` while the mentioned issue happens on `Forward+`

No creo que sea "subdivision_width" ni "subdivision_depth". Es más: eso es
de la malla, no del nodo (aunque no sé si eso hace algo al respecto)
